Research and systems

Projects

Research spanning embodied intelligence, panoramic perception, efficient models, 3D scene understanding, and complex industrial environments.

Current agenda

Research directions

Embodied IntelligenceResearch in progress

CARVE-VLA

A vision-language-action research direction centered on spatially grounded perception, reasoning, and action for embodied agents.

Panoramic GeometryResearch in progress

One Sphere, Many Charts

Group-Consistent Panoramic Depth from Frozen Foundation Models

Panoramic depth estimation that adapts frozen foundation models to spherical geometry through chart-based representations and group consistency.

Efficient IntelligenceExploratory research direction

Lightweight World Models

A first-principles exploration of world-model design that retains planning capability while reducing the cost of inference.

Real-world grounding

From spatial perception to operational systems

Across these projects, recurring technical themes include panoramic and multi-view sensing, vector-space modeling, depth enhancement, point-cloud reconstruction, multimodal fusion, and efficient deployment. This experience provides an applied foundation for current work on embodied intelligence and world models.
